name: Lavender
gardenNote: Lavender shares our little garden with basil, mint, thyme and more.
description: Silver-green leaves, purple flower spikes and a familiar fragrance: English lavender brings colour and scent to a sunny garden.

img.alt: An illustration of five purple lavender flower spikes with green stems and narrow leaves
img.caption: Small flowers, plenty of character.

grow: Use well-drained soil; avoid ground that stays waterlogged.
Leave room around the plant for air to circulate.
Trim after flowering, avoiding cuts into old, leafless wood.
enjoy: Enjoy the flowers in the garden, or dry small bunches for fragrant sachets.
The purple spikes also make a colourful addition to a flower border.
Use the flowers in cooking, for example in desserts or to flavour sugar.
Leave some flowers on the plant for visiting bees.
